risks.risk: Wrong engine model/code (seller may be guessing fitment; photo does not confirm VW 2.0 engine code).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/label on the block (or the stamped code) plus the intake/manifold part number if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used engine (worst case: not confirmed compatible and not confirmed working).

risks.risk: Engine may be incomplete (missing alternator, starter, ECU, sensors, wiring harness, turbo/AC components depending on variant).
risks.proof: A full inventory photo/clip laid out: ECU, starter, alternator, sensors, coils, injectors, alternator/starter, and all hoses/wiring included (or explicitly not included).

risks.risk: Not running / internal damage (no compression/leak test shown).
risks.proof: Video clip of a cold start (or at least a running test) and/or a compression test sheet from a mechanic.

risks.risk: Transmission/ancillaries mismatch (if buyer expects a full package, but photo shows only engine assembly).
risks.proof: Confirm what exactly is included: engine only vs engine + gearbox + starter + alternator + wiring/ECU; show the gearbox bellhousing side if included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only (worst case for buyer expectations).

proof_requests: Send a close-up photo of the engine code/stamp on the block (and any label/plate).
Send a clear photo list of included parts (engine only vs engine + ECU + harness + starter + alternator + sensors).
Send a short video of the engine running (or compression/leak test results).
Confirm compatibility by stating the exact VW engine code (e.g., from the stamp) and show it in the photo.
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly but no readable engine code or markings, so the seller’s VW Passat/Sharan 2.0 compatibility and '2.0 sensor engine' claim cannot be verified remotely. Without that, a worst-case price match to the comparables is not reliable.
